scripts.start: export NODE_ENV=production; n=${ARC_CPUS:-2}; if command -v taskset >/dev/null && taskset -c 0-$((n-1)) true 2>/dev/null; then echo "using taskset, CPUs 0-$((n-1))"; exec taskset -c 0-$((n-1)) tsx server.ts; else echo no taskset; exec tsx server.ts; fi
scripts.pack:extension: rm -f arc-helper.zip && cd extension && zip -qr ../arc-helper.zip . -x README.md STORE.md icons/icon.svg '*.DS_Store'
